description: Every external source used by HKUST Voxel Campus, with licence status. Checked before modelling began.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap (via Overpass API)
sources.dataUsed: HKUST campus boundary (way 40664120); building footprints and tags; roads, footpaths, steps, bridges; water, coastline, woodland, grass, gardens; pitches, car parks, squares; entrances, bus stations, artworks, named points.
sources.role: Geometry of every mapped feature. Guide places (amenities, shops, emergency points) for the student guide.
sources.shippedInSite: Derived block data only (rasterised and meshed). Raw extract cached in data/raw/ (git-ignored).
sources.restrictions: Attribution required; derived databases must stay under ODbL. Queried once by script for a bounded study-area polygon — the website never calls Overpass. The extract came from an Overpass mirror whose data snapshot was dated 2026-07-24.

sources.name: Lands Department, HKSAR Government — Digital Terrain Model (5 m grid)
sources.licence: DATA.GOV.HK Terms and Conditions of Use
sources.dataUsed: Whole_HK_DTM_5m.asc cropped to the study area (274 × 300 cells), resampled to a 1 m grid.
sources.attribution: Terrain: Digital Terrain Model © The Government of the Hong Kong SAR (Lands Department), from DATA.GOV.HK
sources.restrictions: Free for commercial and non-commercial use provided the source is identified and the Government's ownership acknowledged. Published accuracy ±5 m; surface may include vegetation and elevated structures.

sources.name: Lands Department, HKSAR Government — Building (polygons with names and heights)
sources.licence: DATA.GOV.HK Terms and Conditions of Use
sources.dataUsed: 904 building polygons in the study area (CSDI dataset landsd_rcd_1637211194312_35158): building names (English / Chinese), base and top heights, podium / tower type.
sources.role: Building heights and the podium / tower split; official names for buildings OpenStreetMap leaves unnamed; an independent polygon to cross-check each OSM footprint. Footprints still come from OpenStreetMap.
sources.shippedInSite: Derived block heights and building names. A slim copy of the polygons and attributes is kept in data/processed/ for reproducible builds.
sources.attribution: Building names and heights: Building data © The Government of the Hong Kong SAR (Lands Department), from DATA.GOV.HK
sources.restrictions: Free for commercial and non-commercial use provided the source is identified and the Government's ownership acknowledged. Heights are top minus base level of each polygon; they are matched to OSM footprints by overlap, which can mis-assign values where the two datasets disagree.

sources.name: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology — official Campus Map (PDF)
sources.licence: © The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology. No open licence stated.
sources.dataUsed: 48 official building names (English / Chinese) and three place names, transcribed by hand into data/curated/official-hkust.json.
sources.role: Authoritative naming. The map is a schematic without coordinates, so it supplies names only — never positions or shapes.
sources.shippedInSite: Factual names only, with attribution. The PDF and its artwork are NOT shipped.
sources.derivativesPublishable: Facts only — not an open dataset. Seek permission from HKUST before any commercial use.
sources.attribution: Building names: official HKUST Campus Map (© The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology)
sources.restrictions: Not open data. Names were transcribed by hand, so transcription errors are possible. This project is unofficial and not affiliated with or endorsed by HKUST. Zones are a project grouping.

sources.name: HKUST Path Advisor — building list
sources.licence: © The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology. No open licence stated.
sources.dataUsed: The building abbreviations CYT, LSK and IAS.
sources.role: Short building codes shown in search and the inspector.
sources.restrictions: Indoor floor plans and room data from Path Advisor are not used.

sources.name: Photographs on the official HKUST website
sources.licence: © The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology. All rights reserved.
sources.dataUsed: Viewed privately to understand the Academic Building's Piazza façade and the Red Bird sundial.
sources.role: Private visual reference for two models.
sources.shippedInSite: Nothing. No photograph or derivative image is included.
sources.restrictions: Reference only. Most other buildings were not checked against photographs.

sources.name: Lands Department — Hong Kong Imagery Map API (aerial photographs)
sources.licence: © The Government of the Hong Kong SAR. Hong Kong Map Service terms of use; not open data.
sources.dataUsed: 89 aerial-photo tiles of the campus (64 at zoom 18, 25 close-up tiles of the Piazza at zoom 20), looked at next to a top-down render of the model.
sources.role: Private visual reference for the model audit (scripts/audit). Used to spot where the model disagrees with the real campus; each resulting correction is written down by hand in data/manual-overrides.json. Never used as a texture, never traced automatically.
sources.shippedInSite: Nothing. Tiles and comparison sheets stay in data/raw/ (git-ignored).
sources.derivativesPublishable: No — the imagery itself is not redistributed. Only hand-written corrections informed by looking at it are published.
sources.attribution: Aerial Photograph from Lands Department (reference only, not redistributed)
sources.restrictions: Reference only. The photographs' capture date is not stated by the service, so they may be older or newer than the OpenStreetMap snapshot. Only the campus and a 40 m margin were checked.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.dataUsed: Items with a coordinate in the study area: inception year, architect, style and heritage designation of items that are buildings.
sources.role: Building facts in the student guide.

sources.name: Public transport GTFS — Transport Department, HKSAR
sources.licence: DATA.GOV.HK Terms and Conditions of Use
sources.dataUsed: 13 stops in the study area and the routes calling at each.
sources.role: Transit stops and routes in the student guide.
sources.shippedInSite: Stop names, positions and route names.
sources.attribution: Transit data: Transport Department, from DATA.GOV.HK

sources.name: Declared Monuments — Antiquities and Monuments Office, HKSAR
sources.licence: DATA.GOV.HK Terms and Conditions of Use
sources.dataUsed: 0 declared monuments in the study area (name, declaration year, outline).
sources.role: Heritage status in the student guide.
sources.shippedInSite: Status and year of matched buildings.
sources.attribution: Declared monuments: Antiquities and Monuments Office

notUsed: Google Maps / Google Earth, Bing Maps, Apple Maps, Mapbox imagery — not used in any form.
Minecraft / Mojang textures, sounds, logos, fonts or game files — none. All block textures are procedural and original.
